addons.name: Official template catalog (moorage-templates)
addons.description: Connects Literally-davca/moorage-templates as a remote template index with daily refresh.

resources.ram: +1–2 MB (in-memory during daily refresh; ~0 MB idle)

addons.name: Prometheus & Grafana metrics
addons.description: Exposes /metrics for Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics and provides a ready-to-import Grafana dashboard.

addons.name: Proxy & dashboard label detection
addons.description: Automatically detect service web URLs from Traefik, Caddy and Homepage container labels.

addons.name: Restic volume backups
addons.description: Optional scheduled Restic container for encrypted, deduplicated backups of stack volumes.

resources.ram: +0 MB between runs / +30–120 MB during backup job
resources.cpu: ~0% idle / moderate burst during compression & encryption

addons.name: Trivy CVE vulnerability scanner
addons.description: Optional sidecar container for scanning stack container images for known CVEs without bloating the Moorage binary.

resources.ram: +40 MB idle (server) / +150–400 MB during image scan
resources.cpu: ~0% idle / 1–2 cores burst for 5–20s per image scan
